logic.entry: hourly when flat; B0 forced, B1 prior 21 realized hourly funding median times hold minus estimated roundtrip cost above buffer; require full horizon
logic.exit: B0 fixed signal+hold; B1 remaining expected funding minus future exit cost <= buffer or fixed signal+hold; next minute open; then next hourly decision may re-enter
logic.sizing: same floored common lot base quantity on both legs; fraction of contemporaneous known NAV per leg; separate spot cash/perp collateral; no transfers; no borrow
